payload.title: a primitive file-cut for capacity
payload.body: Plan what-ships split the primitive 'supported harness' into six units by file area to fit executor capacity. The plan law says a unit past capacity is split on its concept's factors and, when factors = ∅, SURFACED; a file-cut instead leaves no unit that realizes the concept alone, so no per-unit assay can pass and acceptance falls back to verify. Either the law should admit a removal-shaped primitive to be cut by site with one assay on the whole, or such a concept should be factored (adapter, gates, docs) at design time.
